name: the schema tree is reported per server
description: GET /api/db/schema-diff walks INFORMATION_SCHEMA in three tiers — databases, then tables, then columns — and returns a Server -> Database -> Table -> Column tree per node, the input Phorge's schema comparison expects. The seeded node has one database (phorge_meta_data) with one table (patch_status), so the tree has a stable, small shape whose top node carries the refKey.
